profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Tanium
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer and technical lead with a proven track record of high performance and great teamwork over 17+ years.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building and maintaining the Kubernetes platform for Tanium's cloud products and services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, IBM Cloud Databases
positions.description:
- Automated updates for 20,000+ Kubernetes nodes across 100 clusters and 12 regions, reducing outdated workers from 75% to 5%.
- Streamlined release deployment test automation and processes, reducing deployment time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.
- Delivered several improvements to reduce alert rates by 30%, while number of database deployments grew by 7%.
- Periodically performed on-call duties for the entire estate of tens-of-thousands of database instances.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Red Hat Marketplace
positions.description:
- Lead development efforts on a new marketplace to try, buy, and sell certified software that runs on Red Hat OpenShift.
- Oversaw rapid growth of the engineering team and led various squads of 8-10 developers, while contributing to several areas of the project.
- Developed alerts and runbooks for newly deployed microservices and established on-call rotation processes.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer, ibm.com Digital Marketplace
positions.description:
- Developer on the Universal Master Catalog team for IBM.com Marketplace, responsible for the database backend and REST API development work for the site. 
- Migrated catalog API component from Strongloop and Cloudant to TypeScript, Node.js and MongoDB. Improved response times from 600ms to 35ms average.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Developed a customized educational benchmark tracking system for Michigan schools. Technologies included PHP and MySQL.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Helped 20 students gain understanding of computer programming concepts. Created and graded homework assignments.

publications.title: Managing Kubernetes upgrades at scale for stateful applications
